MEET YOUR FOUNDERS

The women holding space for your reset.

how it began...

Before this became a retreat, it was just two friends by a pool in Bali — soft laughter, easy conversation, and a feeling neither of us wanted to let go of.

the laughter that softened everything.

the conversation that opened something up.

the moment we knew — this feeling was meant to be shared.

Adeline

PILATES INSTRUCTOR • MOVEMENT & WELLNESS

Adeline is a Pilates instructor with nearly 4 years of experience teaching both group and private sessions, with a passion for helping women feel stronger, more confident and connected to their bodies through intentional movement.

Her teaching combines mindful movement, strength, mobility and body awareness, creating sessions that are purposeful yet approachable. She believes Pilates is more than just a workout — it's about understanding your body, moving with intention and building strength that supports you beyond the studio.

Through her classes, Adeline hopes to create a space where women can slow down, reconnect with themselves and leave feeling stronger, more empowered and at home in their bodies.

Sunshine Dorothy

ENERGY HEALER · PILATES & YOGA INSTRUCTOR · INTUITIVE ASTROLOGER

Sunshine is an energy healer and embodiment coach who helps women reconnect with their body, intuition and True Self — guiding them through their personal Soul-Level Glow up.

Her 8 years of coaching experience weaves together Astrology, Tarot & oracle, Akashic Records, energy healing, somatic practices, Pilates and Yoga to uncover what's been keeping you stuck and activate deep empowerment from within.

Her clients and community walk away with a renewed sense of confidence in who they are, and ready to take action for a life they desired.

FAQ

Questions we get asked before saying yes.

I'd be coming alone — is that strange?

Not at all — most of our girls come solo. You'll be part of the group from the moment you arrive, and by the end of it you'll have new friends, not just new photos.

How much leave do I need to take?

Just one day of AL. Feel free to extend your trip on either side — just let us know and we'll help you plan accordingly, including any extended accommodation nights (at your own expense).

I'm not flexible or experienced. Will the sessions be too much?

Not at all — every session is designed to be approachable, with modifications offered so you can move at your own pace.

How do I pay, and what if not enough people sign up?

Full payment via PayNow secures your slot — message us on WhatsApp and we'll send the payment QR code directly. If we don't get enough girls to run it, you'll get a 100% refund.
